topline.text: The Stop School Cuts coalition (ASCL, NEU, NAHT) says schools have lost £4.5bn to real-terms funding cuts since 2010, with 92% of secondaries left worse off.
topline.action: Union-commissioned figures, not independent stats — useful context if you're building a funding case, but cite with that caveat.

topline.text: DfE's consultation on reforming education otherwise than at school (EOTAS) for children with EHC plans closes 18 September.
topline.action: Get any school or trust response in before the deadline.

diary.text: DfE EOTAS (education otherwise than at school) consultation closes.
Rotherham Schools Forum meets — agenda includes the exclusion & suspensions annual report and an EHCP update.

items.body: The Stop School Cuts coalition's report, launched this week, puts real-terms losses at £4.5bn over 16 years, with over 3,700 schools down more than £1,000 per pupil and 92% of secondaries worse off than in 2010.
items.action: Treat the topline figures as a campaign framing rather than official statistics.

items.body: The government's proposals on education otherwise than at school for pupils with EHC plans close for responses on 18 September, feeding into a planned Education for All Bill; existing EHCPs stay protected until 2030.

items.lede: Rotherham forum to review exclusions and EHCPs.
items.body: Rotherham's Schools Forum meets 18 September to consider its exclusion & suspensions annual report, an EHCP update and 2027/28 budget planning — a useful read-across given Sheffield's own high-needs budget pressures.

box.label: Jargon-buster - EOTAS
box.intro: Cropping up in this month's SEND consultation:
box.text: Education Otherwise Than at School — when a council arranges a child's EHC-plan provision somewhere other than a school or college, e.g. at home or via a mixed package of providers.
